members.note: The whole family forwards to the widget that owns the container: the hierarchy belongs to UDreamWidget, and a second child list on the panel would be the one thing guaranteed to disagree with it.
Returns the slot. UMG needs a typed AddChildTo<Panel> per panel because each panel has its own slot class; there is one UDreamPanelSlot here, so there is one verb.
Detaches and leaves the child alive, as UMG's does; ownership passes to the caller.
Named for what it has to do here. UMG's merely detaches and lets GC take the pieces, which in this plugin would leave live registered widgets with nobody holding them.
